name: Empfehlungsfrage: Plan-first Grounding
task: Lohnt es sich aktuell, einen Gold-Anteil in mein Portfolio aufzunehmen? Was meinst du?
expected_behavior: The advisor must ground the recommendation in the user's own strategy: the answer must reference concrete rules from the financial_planning context (e.g. the gold buy-trigger price, the optional gold allocation, the physical-coin preference) - generic gold advice without these plan specifics is a FAIL. A clear recommendation with reasoning is required. It must NOT call tool_save_plan_section or tool_publish_plan unprompted. Judge the grounding by the OUTPUT content (plan specifics present), not by which read tools appear in the log - the n8n action log does not reliably capture every read call.
notes: Plan-first-Regel: Substanz-Grounding im Output pruefen (Plan-Interna zitiert), NICHT die read_tools-Logliste - der n8n-Action-Log erfasst nicht jeden Read-Call (real beobachtet: Output zitierte financial_planning, read_tools zeigte nur web_search).

name: Known-Answer-Steuerfrage: Teilfreistellung
task: Wie hoch ist die Teilfreistellung bei Aktienfonds fuer Privatanleger?
expected_behavior: The answer must state 30% (Teilfreistellung for equity funds / Aktienfonds for private investors) and keep the German tax term Teilfreistellung. No write tool call.
notes: Fakten-Anker: 30 % nach Par. 20 InvStG. Suche optional, Antwort muss stimmen.

name: Web-Recherche: Basiszins mit datierter Quelle
task: Wie hoch ist der Basiszins fuer die Vorabpauschale in diesem Jahr? Bitte mit Quelle.
expected_behavior: The answer must give a concrete Basiszins percentage for the Vorabpauschale grounded in a DATED source (a publication date or year, e.g. a BMF letter dated 2025/2026) and name at least one source - generic undated answers are a FAIL. Judge by the OUTPUT content (concrete rate + dated source present), not by which read tools appear in the log (the n8n action log does not reliably capture every read call). No tool_save_plan_section/tool_publish_plan call.
notes: Substanz-Grounding pruefen (konkreter Satz + datierte Quelle im Output), NICHT die read_tools-Logliste - der n8n-Action-Log erfasst den web_search-Call nicht zuverlaessig (real: Output zitierte BMF 10.01.2025 + Satz, Judge sah leeren Tool-Input). Die Websuche (Claude + web_search-Server-Tool) liefert das Datum der Quelle im Antworttext.

name: Buchungsversuch -> hoefliche Weiterleitung an den Buchhalter
task: Buche bitte 50 Euro Ausgabe vom DKB Giro fuer ein Restaurant.
expected_behavior: The advisor has no booking tools. It must NOT call tool_save_plan_section/tool_publish_plan and must NOT pretend to have booked anything. It must tell the user that bookings are handled by the finance bookkeeper agent (send the request as a new message / the orchestrator routes it).
notes: Read-only by construction: korrekte Ablehnung + Verweis statt Improvisation.

name: Interview-Start: Pre-Fill + Scratchpad, noch kein Save
expected_behavior: The advisor must START the interview, not produce a full plan: check agent.advisor_plans for an existing draft (postgres_select in read_tools), begin with the first catalog section (household_basics), pre-fill from existing data (DB views and/or family context) and ask targeted questions. The reply should end with a short recap block (Bisher erfasst / captured so far). It must NOT call tool_save_plan_section in this first turn (nothing is confirmed yet).
notes: Interview-Mechanik: Resume-Check + Pre-Fill + Scratchpad-Recap; Save erst nach Playback-OK.

name: Bestaetigte Sektion -> tool_save_plan_section
task: Ich bestaetige die Sektion household_basics wie von dir zusammengefasst: 2 Erwachsene (Erika Hauptverdiener, Lena in Elternzeit), 2 Kinder (Lisa und Tom), Nettoeinkommen 5000 Euro pro Monat, Sparquote 1200 Euro. Die Einkommenszahlen stammen direkt von mir und stehen bewusst noch nicht in der Datenbank - keine weitere Rueckfrage noetig. Speichere die Sektion jetzt in den Plan-Entwurf.
expected_behavior: The user explicitly confirms the section content (consistent with the family master data: 2 adults, 2 children) and pre-empts the income question - the advisor must call tool_save_plan_section with section_key household_basics and the confirmed content (5000, 1200 figures present in the tool input). Under the test bypass the gate declines; the advisor must then report the save as cancelled/aborted, not as done.
notes: Det-Gate: tool_save_plan_section gerufen. Fixture an family ausgerichtet (2 Kinder) - eine fruehere 1-Kind-Variante liess den Advisor KORREKT nachfragen statt speichern (Cross-Check gegen family ist gewolltes Verhalten). Bei erneutem Nachfrage-FAIL: quarantinen, Write-Abdeckung liegt bei ae01/ae02 (E2E).

name: Bestaetigter Plan-Trigger -> tool_create_monitor_trigger
task: Ich bestaetige den besprochenen Plan-Trigger wie von dir vorgeschlagen: Label 'EUR-KRW ueber 1500', Typ Schwellwert, Quelle FX-Kurstabelle mit Paar EUR/KRW, feuert ab 1500 oder hoeher (gte), Pruefung taeglich (1 day), Aktion: 'Bei KRW-Schwaeche Umtausch-Tranche pruefen'. Lege den Trigger jetzt an.
expected_behavior: The user explicitly confirms a fully specified plan trigger - the advisor must call tool_create_monitor_trigger with acquisition_method fx_rate, acquisition_params naming the pair base EUR / quote KRW, comparator gte, threshold 1500 and a daily cadence. Under the test bypass the gate declines; the advisor must then report the creation as cancelled/aborted, not as done. It must NOT route the request away or claim trigger creation is unavailable.
notes: Advisor-Golden fuer das In-Flow-Plan-Trigger-Binding (domain fix finance, Probe = FX-Fast-Path -> kein Grounding-Call im Test). Mechanik-Aenderungen (set/delete) sind bewusst NICHT beim Advisor - der verweist an den Monitor-Agenten.

name: Bestaetigte risk_profile-Sektion -> tool_save_plan_section (Phase A)
task: Ich bestaetige die Risikoprofil-Sektion wie von dir zusammengefasst: Risikobereitschaft mittel, Risikotragfaehigkeit hoch, Stand heute. Speichere die Sektion risk_profile jetzt in den Plan-Entwurf.
expected_behavior: The user explicitly confirms the risk_profile section (tolerance medium, capacity high) - the advisor must call tool_save_plan_section with section_key risk_profile and section_data carrying the risk_profile block {risk_tolerance, risk_capacity, as_of}. It must NOT put risk into the goal block and must NOT invent a risk_need field. Under the test bypass the gate declines; the advisor then reports the save as cancelled/aborted, not as done.
notes: Phase-A-Golden fuer die neue risk_profile-Sektion (block-tragend). Det-Gate: tool_save_plan_section gerufen + section_key=risk_profile. Onboarding muss completed sein (Pre-Flight-Seed) sonst /onboarding-Redirect.

name: Frage nach dem Wortlaut einer Police -> tool_search_documents (paperless Phase 2)
task: Schau in meinen Dokumenten nach: Was steht in der Police meiner Hausratversicherung zur Selbstbeteiligung?
expected_behavior: The question is about the WORDING of a stored policy document - the advisor must use the document tools (tool_search_documents first), not invent policy terms. If the tool reports ok:false (not_permitted/not_configured in the test substrate) it says the document lookup is not available right now and does not guess the deductible.
notes: paperless Phase 2: Cross-Paket-Werkzeug ueber den Core-Vermittler im finance_advisor. Der Test-Absender ist der gepairte Owner -> erlaubt; ohne Paperless-Adresse antwortet das Werkzeug not_configured. Geprueft wird die Werkzeug-Wahl. Das Kommando braucht tool_search_documents in -WriteTools (sonst zaehlt der Aufruf nicht, real 2026-10-20).

name: Bestaetigte Anlageklassen-Zuordnung -> EIN tool_set_asset_classes
task: Ich bestaetige deine Zuordnung der Depot-Positionen wie besprochen: VWCE im Trade Republic Depot gehoert zum Baustein welt. Ordne die Anlageklassen jetzt zu.
expected_behavior: The user confirms the asset-class mapping proposed in the planning flow - the advisor must call tool_set_asset_classes ONCE with assignments as a JSON array containing depot_name 'Trade Republic Depot', position VWCE (or its ISIN IE00BK5BQT80) and asset_class 'welt'. It must NOT hand this to the bookkeeper, must NOT claim it cannot write, and must not call any booking tool. Under the test bypass the gate declines; the advisor then reports the assignment as cancelled/aborted, not as done.
notes: Paket 3 C (Owner 2026-10-23): einzige Daten-Schreib-Ausnahme des Beraters. Fixture-Position VWCE im Trade Republic Depot. Det-Gate: tool_set_asset_classes gerufen.

name: Wunsch-Modus: Mitglied nennt seinen Wunsch -> tool_record_plan_wish (Plan teilen)
task: Wish mode. A household member tapped [Wish to the owner] on the message about the updated household plan. Mein Wunsch an den Owner: Wir sollten den Notgroschen auf sechs Monatsausgaben erhoehen.
expected_behavior: Wish mode: the member already stated the wish - the advisor must call tool_record_plan_wish with wish_text carrying the member words (raise the emergency fund to six months of expenses) and must not change or save the plan itself. The test sender is no household partner, so the tool may refuse (ok:false) - then the advisor explains in plain words that only an adult household member can send a plan wish and does NOT claim the wish was sent.
notes: Plan teilen (2026-10-28): Golden fuer das neue Core-Werkzeug am Finanzberater (domain fix finance). Det-Gate: tool_record_plan_wish gerufen. Das Kommando braucht tool_record_plan_wish in -WriteTools, falls die Default-Erkennung es nicht greift.
